execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."addresses" (
  "city" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "country" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "label" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "phone" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "postal_code" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "street" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."inquiries" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "event_date" date,
  "guest_count" int4,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'new' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "inquiries_guest_count_positive_3cce74cf" CHECK (guest_count > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "inquiries_status_check_b4d44f3f" CHECK ("status" IN ('new', 'handled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."invoices" (
  "billing_city" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "billing_country" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "billing_first_name" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "billing_last_name" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "billing_postal_code" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "billing_street" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "fiscal_year" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "issued_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "order_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sequence_number" int4 NOT NULL,
  "total_amount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "invoices_sequence_number_positive_6ed258b7" CHECK (sequence_number > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "invoices_total_amount_non_negative_b70a6922" CHECK (total_amount >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."media" (
  "alt_text" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "file_path" character varying(2048) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "mime_type" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order_lines" (
  "discount_percent" numeric(5,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(5,2) NOT NULL,
  "order_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "product_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "product_label" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "unit_price" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("order_id", "product_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "order_lines_discount_percent_range_eaefd8d7" CHECK (discount_percent >= 0 AND discount_percent <= 100),
  CONSTRAINT "order_lines_quantity_positive_4402679f" CHECK (quantity > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "order_lines_unit_price_non_negative_3c1fb11f" CHECK (unit_price >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order_statuses" (
  "changed_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "order_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "order_statuses_status_check_08123348" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."orders" (
  "billing_city" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "billing_country" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "billing_first_name" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "billing_last_name" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "billing_postal_code" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "billing_street" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "delivery_city" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "delivery_country" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "delivery_first_name" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "delivery_last_name" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "delivery_phone" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "delivery_postal_code" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "delivery_street" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "paid_at" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "orders_paid_at_required_49910823" CHECK (NOT (status IN ('processing', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND paid_at IS NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "orders_status_check_08123348" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."post_media" (
  "media_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "post_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("post_id", "media_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."posts" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "cover_media_id" int4,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "published_at" timestamptz,
  "slug" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL,
  "title" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "posts_published_at_required_c08a5e53" CHECK (NOT (status = 'published' AND published_at IS NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "posts_status_check_6db19c90" CHECK ("status" IN ('draft', 'published', 'archived'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."product_media" (
  "media_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "product_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("product_id", "media_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."products" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "label" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "price" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "slug" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "stock_quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "products_price_non_negative_faabb23d" CHECK (price >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "products_stock_non_negative_eb99aa6a" CHECK (stock_quantity >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tokens" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "used_at" timestamptz,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "value_hash" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "tokens_type_check_c88c716f" CHECK ("type" IN ('email_verification', 'password_reset'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,
  "email" character varying(300) NOT NULL,
  "email_verified_at" timestamptz,
  "first_name" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "last_name" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" character varying(255),
  "role" text DEFAULT 'user' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "users_email_format_58ffc0a7" CHECK (email LIKE '%_@_%._%'),
  CONSTRAINT "users_guest_no_password_4605cda1" CHECK ((role = 'guest' AND password_hash IS NULL) OR (role <> 'guest' AND password_hash IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "users_role_check_e56de5de" CHECK ("role" IN ('user', 'guest', 'admin'))
)
